title: UX-016 administration boundary with step screenshots
fixture: Actual React administration screens. Controlled browser credentials, role, records, and BFF responses. Save probes persist the received UI payload without replacing it with expected values. Declared clock emulation controls field timers. Proposed accessibility and source-risk expectations remain separate from business approval.

frames.claim: The visible state when the test failed.
limits: The screenshot establishes visible state only. It does not prove request, storage, timing, or business results.
